learning_outcomes.text: The student masters the basic concepts of data communication.
The student has knowledge of the components and functions of communication building blocks.
The student has knowledge of, and can make an application-oriented choice from all possible implementations of the 7-layer OSI model.

syllabus_topics: Analog data communication (voltage and current as data carrier)
Parallel data communication (Centronics, HPIB, GPIB, LCD interface, handshake,...)
Serial communication: - Topology of a connection - Protocols; - Level shifters - Coding and modulation
Asynchronous communication: - Frame format - Handshake; - Flow control; - UART; - 1-wire interface - CAN - RS485...
Synchronous communication: - Shift registers - SPI - IIC....

assessment_methods.method: Partial or permanent evaluation with exam during the exam period

assessment_rules: The retake will follow the same modalities as the first exam opportunity. There are no partial transfers for this course unit. The grading scale is from 1-20.
